label: XSYS-001-A1 PART 2 - EXISTING NOMINAL DATA - NOT CONFIRMATORY

A_residual_model.interpretation: trapezoidal IMU integral of two consecutive SIH draws: std 0.01/sqrt(2), lag-1 0.5

E2_identity_all_pairs.construction: fraction of coincident draws at the best lag within +-40 steps (0.16 s), 25-44 s (25-30 s when a sweep flight is involved, before its onset)

D_original_design_emulation.construction: two same-family launches treated as two conditions with onsets 25 s and 25 s + delta (the original design's separations are 0.5 .. 5 s); DX1 over their spans

BC_statistic_lag_correlation_original_se.meaning: correlation of a frozen null statistic between two onsets delta apart in ONE noise stream = between two same-family conditions of the original design

replay_at_other_lags.construction: one representative per family; span [25, 44) s of a against [12, 44) s of b, every lag
